name: Wide-Angled Seated Forward Bend
description: Seated with the legs wide, folding forward between them.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Sit tall and open your legs wide, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
Put your hands on the floor in front of you.

keyframes.name: Sit in Staff Pose
keyframes.cue: Sit tall with the legs straight out in front.

keyframes.name: Wide-Angled Seated Bend
keyframes.cue: Open the legs wide and walk the hands forward.

cues: Fold only as far as the back stays long.
